executionNote: The complete 69-test suite passed in one run after fixing member appointment ordering and pickup activity propagation. This includes 68 browser checks and one domain regression test. Screenshot and accessibility checks wait for loaded page content.
limits: Automated accessibility and selected keyboard smoke checks are not formal WCAG conformance.
No live backend, healthcare service, authentication, pharmacy transmission, booking, or email delivery is implemented.
Browser testing used Chrome; Safari, Firefox, real assistive-technology users, and email-client rendering remain future work.
